questions.question: What problem can occur when using an automatic notch filter (ANF) to remove interfering carriers while receiving CW signals?

choices.A: Removal of the CW signal as well as the interfering carrier
choices.B: Any nearby signal passing through the DSP system will overwhelm the desired signal

questions.answer: Removal of the CW signal as well as the interfering carrier

questions.question: Which of the following types of noise can often be reduced by a digital noise reduction?
Which of the following types of noise are removed by a noise blanker?
How can conducted noise from an automobile battery charging system be suppressed?

choices.A: By installing filter capacitors in series with the alternator leads
choices.B: By installing a noise suppression resistor and a blocking capacitor at the battery
choices.C: By installing a high-pass filter in series with the radio’s power lead and a low-pass filter in parallel with the antenna feed line
choices.D: By installing ferrite chokes on the charging system leads

questions.answer: By installing ferrite chokes on the charging system leads

questions.question: What is used to suppress radio frequency interference from a line-driven AC motor?

choices.A: A high-pass filter in series with the motor’s power leads
choices.B: A brute-force AC-line filter in series with the motor’s power leads
choices.C: A bypass capacitor in series with the motor’s field winding
choices.D: A bypass choke in parallel with the motor’s field winding

questions.answer: A brute-force AC-line filter in series with the motor’s power leads

questions.question: What type of electrical interference can be caused by computer network equipment?

choices.A: A loud AC hum in the audio output of your station’s receiver
choices.B: A clicking noise at intervals of a few seconds
choices.C: The appearance of unstable modulated or unmodulated signals at specific frequencies
choices.D: A whining-type noise that continually pulses off and on

questions.answer: The appearance of unstable modulated or unmodulated signals at specific frequencies

questions.question: Which of the following can cause shielded cables to radiate or receive interference?

choices.A: Low inductance ground connections at both ends of the shield
choices.B: Common-mode currents on the shield and conductors
choices.D: Tying all ground connections to a common point resulting in differential-mode currents in the shield

questions.answer: Common-mode currents on the shield and conductors

What undesirable effect can occur when using a noise blanker?

choices.A: Received audio in the speech range might have an echo effect
choices.B: The audio frequency bandwidth of the received signal might be compressed
choices.C: Strong signals may be distorted and appear to cause spurious emissions
choices.D: FM signals can no longer be demodulated

questions.answer: Strong signals may be distorted and appear to cause spurious emissions

questions.question: Which of the following can create intermittent loud roaring or buzzing AC line interference?

choices.A: Arcing contacts in a thermostatically controlled device
choices.B: A defective doorbell or doorbell transformer inside a nearby residence

questions.question: What could be the cause of local AM broadcast band signals combining to generate spurious signals on the MF or HF bands?

choices.A: One or more of the broadcast stations is transmitting an over-modulated signal
choices.B: Nearby corroded metal connections are mixing and reradiating the broadcast signals
choices.C: You are receiving skywave signals from a distant station
choices.D: Your station receiver IF amplifier stage is overloaded

questions.answer: Nearby corroded metal connections are mixing and reradiating the broadcast signals

questions.question: What causes interference received as a series of carriers at regular intervals across a wide frequency range?
Where should a station AC surge protector be installed?

choices.C: On the single point ground panel
choices.D: On a ground rod outside the station

questions.answer: On the single point ground panel

questions.question: What is the purpose of a single point ground panel?

choices.A: Remove AC power in case of a short-circuit
choices.B: Prevent common-mode transients in multi-wire systems
choices.C: Eliminate air gaps between protected and non-protected circuits
choices.D: Ensure all lightning protectors activate at the same time

questions.answer: Ensure all lightning protectors activate at the same time
